claims.claim: Symbotic's August 2026 SEC-filed Q3 release reported $721 million revenue, up 22% year over year, $55 million net income, $95 million adjusted EBITDA and $1.7 billion cash, materially extending the source-addressed operating record beyond earlier packet evidence.

The June 2026 10-Q states backlog was approximately $22.5 billion and that Walmart and Exol agreements comprised the vast majority, preserving a major customer-concentration dependency alongside scale.

risks.risk: Backlog remains highly concentrated in Walmart and Exol, so deployment timing, acceptance and contract changes at those relationships can materially affect realization.

unknowns.unknown: Backlog size does not by itself establish future gross margin, cash conversion or renewal economics.

claims.claim: Q3 results demonstrate continued deployment-driven growth and improved profitability, but the concentration disclosure means execution quality must be assessed together with customer dependency rather than from backlog magnitude alone.

risks.risk: Large contracted backlog can mask timing and customer concentration risk if deployments or acceptance milestones slip.

unknowns.unknown: This assist does not create Alpha numeric scores, risk values or confidence calibration.
